title: ApexBrasil, Missao ao Web Summit 9 a 13 de novembro de 2026: Regulamento de participacao (PDF)
what_it_says: ApexBrasil's mission rules for 2026 give the 2025 Brazilian delegation as 380 companies, 247 of them supported by ApexBrasil, Sebrae Startups and Serpro, the rest by the state Sebraes.
